nodes.description: EthForwarder.destinationAddress: address payable public state variable that receives all forwarded Ether.
Ownable._owner: private address storing the privileged owner account.
msg.sender: external caller address, untrusted; used as constructor destination, event emitter and owner check subject.
pay(): external payable function emitting Forwarded and forwarding msg.value to destinationAddress via _send.
flush(): external function that forwards the entire contract balance to destinationAddress via _send.
setDestinationAddress(address payable): onlyOwner setter writing the destinationAddress state variable.
_send(address payable,uint): internal helper performing the low-level value transfer.
Low-level external call _to.call{value:_amount}("") in _send: forwards arbitrary Ether to an owner-controlled address and may invoke fallback code.
EthForwarder constructor: initializes destinationAddress from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender(), gating privileged functions.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function writing the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
owner(): view function returning the _owner state variable.
_msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender, used by Ownable access control.
_msgData(): internal view returning msg.data (returns calldata, no untrusted value flow).
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, written into the _owner state variable.
_destination parameter of setDestinationAddress, written into destinationAddress.
_to parameter of _send, target address of the low-level call.
_amount parameter of _send, Ether value of the low-level call.
local address msgSender in the Ownable constructor, holding _msgSender() before assignment to _owner.
local bool sent in _send capturing the success flag of the low-level call, checked with require.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender (untrusted caller) to the destinationAddress state variable.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke the payable pay() function.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke flush(), draining the contract balance.
pay() calls the internal helper _send to transfer msg.value.
flush() calls _send with the whole contract balance, enabling state-changing reentry before completion.
_send executes the low-level external call unsafe_send_call, transferring Ether before any state resolution.
The low-level call to destinationAddress can execute recipient fallback code that reenters flush()/pay().
pay() reads destinationAddress as the recipient of the forwarded value.
flush() reads destinationAddress as the recipient of the whole contract balance.
setDestinationAddress writes the privileged destinationAddress state variable.
onlyOwner guards setDestinationAddress, restricting who may redirect funds.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership, restricting ownership changes.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership, restricting owner renunciation.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), removing access control.
onlyOwner reads _owner and compares it against the current caller.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller identity.
_msgSender() feeds the onlyOwner authorization check (_owner == _msgSender()).
setDestinationAddress writes the _destination parameter into destinationAddress.
The _to parameter is the call target of the low-level value transfer.
The _amount parameter provides the value of the low-level value transfer.
_amount is the value passed through _send; no arithmetic checks exist on caller-supplied value.
The sent local captures the low-level call success flag that require(sent) enforces.
The constructor initializes destinationAddress during deployment.
Local msgSender (from _msgSender) is assigned to the _owner state variable at deployment.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter used only by transferOwnership to update _owner; fold it into the function node.
_destination is a parameter used only by setDestinationAddress to write destinationAddress; fold it into the function node.
_to is a parameter consumed only inside _send as the low-level call target; fold it into the helper function.
_amount is a parameter consumed only inside _send as the call value; fold it into the helper function.
local msgSender exists only inside the EthForwarder/Ownable constructor initialization; fold it into the constructor.
local sent is the direct result check of the low-level call; fold it into the unsafe_send_call operation.
